System text, messages, tool descriptio"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"ns, JSON parameter schemas, raw plugin identifiers, raw skill provider/source identifiers, and AGENT"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"S paths or contents are never returned."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"**Equality fingerprints are not privacy protection.** A plain SHA-256 digest of a low-entropy or kno"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"wn prompt/schema lets an observer confirm guesses offline. Restarting or unloading loses all observations."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- Loader entries do not identify the bundle, profile, override, or dependency that introduced them.
"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"- Plugin inventory reveals ordered enablement and lifecycle categories, but never raw entry ids, pac"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"kage names, file URLs, absolute paths, or patch specifiers.
- A tool name or schema does not identif"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"y its owning plugin.
- Skill names remain visible because they are the public callable identity; sou"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"rce/provider are reduced to fixed categories. A skill name itself may still be sensitive if a deploy"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"ment chooses a sensitive name.
- AGENTS location categories are durable injected-source metadata, no"},{"id":"p24s7","text":"t a filesystem inventory or proof of hidden instructions.
- Adjacent observations cover actual ordin"},{"id":"p24s8","text":"ary `llm/stream` calls seen while this plugin is mounted. Earlier requests, auxiliary calls, and obs"},{"id":"p24s9","text":"ervations lost on unload or restart are unavailable."}],"truncated":true}
